rows: What makes Tyrian purple purple rather than blue?
Bromine substituents at 6-position of each indole ring — shifts absorption from 610nm (blue) to 580nm (red-purple)
How could the same Murex snail make blue tekhelet?
Without air exposure: non-brominated indigo forms (blue). With air: brominated dibromoindigo forms (purple).
Why did cochineal replace kermes so rapidly?
6–15× more dye per unit weight (carminic acid 17–24% vs kermesic acid ~1.5–3%) — immediate economic advantage
Why did it take Europeans 180 years to discover cochineal is an insect?
Spain deliberately obscured the source; dried insects look like grain; Anton van Leeuwenhoek finally confirmed with microscope in 1703
Dried female Dactylopius coccus (scale insect) bodies — carminic acid, anthraquinone glycoside
How does mordant change cochineal's color?
Alum → scarlet/crimson; tin → brilliant scarlet; iron → gray-purple; the carminic acid molecule forms different coordination complexes
Soluble dye precipitated onto inorganic substrate (usually Al(OH)₃) → insoluble particle usable as pigment
What destroyed the madder industry in 1869?
Simultaneous synthesis of alizarin (the active compound) by Perkin and Graebe/Liebermann — same compound, fraction of cost
